# Copilot instructions

Read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) first. It is the canonical workflow
contract for this repository.

## Working rules

- GitHub is the live source of truth for issues, milestones, CI, and releases.
- Non-trivial changes require an issue and a milestone before implementation.
- Use the canonical branch format: `<actor>/<type>/<scope>/<task>-<id>`.
- Keep PR titles and squash commits in Conventional Commit format.
- Keep Prisma schema changes paired with migrations and mention the impact in the PR.
- Keep workflow guidance in `CONTRIBUTING.md` instead of duplicating it here.
